t23_group_turnover.caveat: Complete.end precedes trace writeback and lane release. The residual also includes ACK polling, group retirement/claim/publication and arrival; it is not a measured single helper or pure idle. Each row reconciles exactly; medians of separate pieces need not sum to the gap median.
